derived_quantities_not_additional_measur.note: The paired diameters and direct lip-thickness reading do not define a consistent uniform shell. Preserve all raw observations rather than silently correcting one to agree with another. OD/ID differences are apparent radial thicknesses, not a measurement of thickness normal to a curved wall.

inside_stations.basis: Owner-measured rough ID; axial station explicitly confirmed
Inferred from measured OD and assumed uniform wall; axial station approximate

working_cad_profile.outer_profile_rule: Use a documented 1.15 mm working wall around the selected inside profile; resulting model OD need not equal every conflicting raw OD. CAD must state whether the wall is a radial offset or a normal-thickness construction.
working_cad_profile.interpolation_between_stations: A CAD interpolation, not measured curvature
working_cad_profile.final_taper_41_75_to_45_55: Shape and handle attachment intrusion are not measured; any rendered closure is provisional
working_cad_profile.supersedes_for_new_work: The earlier assumed D50 at z13 to D34 at z43 profile

print_feedback.owner_report: New design fits inside the bell; seems a little small radially.
print_feedback.speaker_capture_feedback: Opening around the magnet could be smaller/tighter.
print_feedback.fastener_feedback: Printed PCB/capture holes did not accommodate presumed M3 screws; owner asked whether smaller screws and heat-set inserts were intended.
print_feedback.prior_hardware_contract: M2 screws; 2.2 mm PCB clearance drills; D3 x L4 insert envelopes were unqualified placeholders, not M3 receptacles.
print_feedback.note: Physical fit feedback does not establish retention strength, live-cell insulation, temperature behavior or finished-PCBA fit.

new_design_requests.cell_candidate: Vapcell T8 16340 button top, provisional D16.4 x L34.0 mm from seller
new_design_requests.battery_retention: PCB contacts with captive insulating plastic structure, wire-free if feasible
new_design_requests.insulation_note: This is a design target, not measured clearance or a safety rating. Include the negative cell can, both end contacts, fasteners, USB shell, side directions and insertion/service motion; highest-z clearance alone is insufficient.
new_design_requests.protection: Compact whole-cell protection revision; boost-only protection is not a substitute
new_design_requests.flash: W25Q16JVUXIQ TR, 2 MB, new USON-8 2 x 3 mm footprint
new_design_requests.usb: Prefer maximum supported connector protrusion, ideally flush with the working outside shell, plus a supported insulated port and feasible removal path
new_design_requests.service: Define shell attachment and reversible cartridge removal before routing
new_design_requests.routing: Show complete placed FreeCAD assembly to owner before committing to routing
